references.text: Mentions the temple of Baal-Berith, which is the same temple called 'the house of El-Berith' in verse 46
Continuation of the account where the people in Shechem's tower die in the fire that Abimelech starts
Refers to Baal-Berith as the god the Israelites began to worship after Gideon's death
Mentions 'the house of Millo' and the inhabitants of Shechem, who are connected to the tower in Shechem
Jotham's curse over the men of Shechem, which is now fulfilled as they seek refuge
